_comment: Per-string context pushed to Crowdin by `npm run i18n:context`. One line per key saying where the string appears and what constrains it — the facts a translator cannot get from the English alone. Written when the string is, by whoever ran /wording. Keys mirror en.json.
title: Dialog title once the reader chooses to give credentials. Atmospheric, one line.
legend: Fieldset legend above the three inputs.
email: Label for the email input. One word.
username: Label for the name input. One word.
password: Label for the password input. One word.
submit: Primary button of the credentials form.
back: Button returning to the previous choice.
cancel: Button dismissing the form without signing in. Softer than a bare Cancel.
errors.wrong_password: Inline error under the form when the credentials are rejected. The desk refuses without explaining — do not add a reason.
errors.generic: Inline error under the form when the request itself failed. Says the fault is the archive's, not the reader's.
